programmes.d: Matt Dillon hunts a gang that has shattered one safe after another with nitroglycerine.
Kitty helps Marshal Matt Dillon switch identities with a killer in order to escape when they are kidnapped by outlaws.
Two men return to Dodge City to find the man who shot their father in the back at the Long Branch saloon 12 years before.
At Parkertown a trap awaits drifter Bob Johnson who is seeking revenge for the murder of two of his friends.
A cattle baron and a legendary frontiersman involve Marshal Matt Dillon in their life-and-death dispute over a hat.
Kitty Russell and a young gunsmith from the East are abducted from a stagecoach on the trail to Dodge City.
A love-sick roustabout faces a lynch mob when he accidentally kills a popular young cowhand.
A fur trapper whose adopted Indian son is beaten and left to die by five Army deserters sets out to track down the assailants.
Marshal Dillon heads into Mexico in pursuit of four fugitives wanted for killing his friend, a retiring sheriff.
Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo. Feat: Ivan Rassimov & Mickey Hargitay.
An Indian agent's unduly stern restrictions lead to death on the reservation and the arrest of Matt Dillon for murder.
A bewhiskered water witch shows up in Dodge City during a drought and promises to find water despite the skeptics.
An ex-outlaw offers to help Marshal Dillon track down members of his old gang and talk them out of hiding.
A wealthy rancher has three drifters trampled by his horsemen after he accuses them of stealing a calf.
A young boy is groomed as a gunfighter to seek vengeance for the wrong done to his father

Matt joins a trail drive to prevent a conflict between the drivers and some hide cutters. He is finally forced to kill the hide-cutters in a shoot-out, but he helps give a 16-year-old boy a chance at an honest life.
A small, ornery Irishman named O'Quillian spreads dissension and disaster in Dodge City.
A slick-talking salesman, attended by three dissatisfied customers, is rescued by a farm widow.
An impoverished widower is accused of stealing money from a bank in order to feed his two small children.
Kitty saves the life of a fellow stagecoach traveler and becomes deeply involved in his personal life.
A respected rancher is found to have been the notoriously cruel commandant of a Civil War prison camp.
Doc Adams is in jeopardy when he is the only witness to a killing, and the murderer becomes his patient.
Three bounty hunters hold Doc, Kitty, Sam, and Louie captive in the Long Branch and offer to exchange them for a prisoner in jail.
